risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (338.4), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, FOMC event in 2 days, and critical earnings binary event in 4 days create compounded volatility and execution risk for PG.
